comment: cmgen turns assets/coin/studio-env.hdr into the prefiltered cubemap Android's Filament renderer needs. It ships as a Maven artifact of the Filament release, so the version here MUST match the com.google.android.filament dependencies in apps/android/app/build.gradle.kts — a mismatched KTX and runtime is a silent wrong-lighting bug, not a load failure. Checksums are pinned rather than fetched, so a tampered or rebuilt binary fails the download. Bump: scripts/build-coin-ibl.mjs --refresh prints a new block.
